job.title: Vessel Operations Coordinator - Australia & Southeast Asia
job.description:
• Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane Location
  • Extensive Travel | Unique Operational Opportunity | Defence & Maritime
  • Up to $134k + super

Looking for a role that takes you beyond the office? This is an opportunity to coordinate the operational support of Navy vessels visiting ports across Australia and Southeast Asia, with extensive domestic and international travel.

We're seeking a proactive, organised and adaptable professional who enjoys coordinating people, managing logistics and solving problems in a fast-paced environment.

No previous Defence or Navy experience is required.

 If you have a background in logistics, transport, shipping, operations or another coordination-focused environment, this could be an exciting next step in your career.

The Opportunity:

You'll play a key role in coordinating the logistics and operational support required when Navy vessels visit ports across Australia and Southeast Asia.
Working closely with Defence representatives, vessel crews, shipping agents, port authorities and local service providers, you'll ensure requirements are understood, resources are coordinated and operations run safely and efficiently.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility, variety and the opportunity to develop specialised experience in Defence and maritime operations.

Please note: This role involves a minimum of 10 days of travel per month across Australia and Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate logistics and operational support for Navy vessel visits across domestic and international ports.
  • Act as the on-site operational lead, ensuring services are delivered safely, efficiently and within required timeframes.
  • Liaise with Defence personnel, vessel crews, shipping agents, port authorities and third-party service providers.
  • Coordinate operational staff and ensure tasks are completed to the required standards.
  • Manage changing priorities, troubleshoot issues and respond to time-critical operational requirements.
  • Monitor compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, operational procedures and relevant regulations.
  • Build effective relationships with stakeholders and maintain a professional, customer-focused approach.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational processes and service delivery.

About You

We're open to candidates from a range of industries. You don't need direct Defence experience, but you will need the confidence and capability to coordinate complex activities, communicate effectively and take ownership of outcomes.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience in logistics, transport, shipping, maritime, operations, supply chain or a similar environment.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to coordinate multiple activities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach to problem-solving.
  • The ability to work autonomously, adapt to changing circumstances and remain calm under pressure.
  • Experience working in a safety-conscious, regulated or operational environment.
  • Confidence coordinating people and ensuring work is completed safely and efficiently.
  • Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • A genuine willingness to travel extensively, including at least 10 days per month across Australia and Southeast Asia.
  • The ability to obtain an Australian Government NV1 security clearance.

Why Apply?

  • A role with variety: No two port visits or operational challenges will be exactly the same.
  • Travel opportunities: Work across Australia and Southeast Asia as part of your regular responsibilities.
  • Career development: Build experience in a specialised operational environment without needing a Defence background.
  • Meaningful responsibility: Coordinate people, services and logistics to support important naval operations.
  • Transferable skills valued: Bring your existing operations or logistics experience and apply it in a new setting.

Interested? If you're an organised and adaptable operations professional looking for a role that combines logistics, stakeholder coordination, problem-solving and international travel, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to find out more about this unique opportunity.

Please note: The successful candidate must be able to obtain an Australian Government NV1 security clearance.

job.title: Property Partnerships & Operations Lead
job.description:
• $85,000 + Super + Performance Bonus
  • Sydney Location / Mostly WFH
  • This role requires you have worked within Property previously

Take ownership. Build relationships. Drive results.

Are you an organised, commercially minded property professional who enjoys building relationships, converting opportunities and keeping operations running smoothly?

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing property services business in a hands-on role where you’ll take ownership of day-to-day operations across client relationships, new enquiries, scheduling and service delivery.

Working closely with the Director, you’ll play a key role in ensuring clients receive outstanding service, opportunities are converted into bookings, and the operation runs efficiently.

This is a position for someone who enjoys autonomy, takes initiative and thrives on making things happen.

The Opportunity This role offers the opportunity to step beyond traditional administration and take genuine ownership of a business operation.

You’ll work across client relationship management, business development, operational coordination and process improvement, with the autonomy to identify issues, solve problems and improve how things are done.
Key Responsibilities

  • Client Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with real estate agents, conveyancers, solicitors and other property industry professionals, encouraging repeat and referral business.
  • Enquiry Management & Sales: Manage inbound enquiries, respond to quotes and follow-ups, and convert suitable opportunities into confirmed bookings.
  • Operational Coordination: Oversee daily inspection bookings, allocate inspectors, manage scheduling changes and ensure time-sensitive requests are handled efficiently.
  • Workflow Management: Maintain oversight of the shared inbox, prioritise urgent matters and coordinate outsourced administration to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.
  • Systems & Administration: Maintain accurate client and booking records, manage quotes, invoices and outstanding actions, and confidently use CRM and operational systems.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve workflows, service delivery and enquiry conversion, taking a proactive approach to resolving issues before they affect clients.

About You You’re a proactive and resourceful professional who enjoys variety, takes ownership and can confidently balance customer service, sales and operational responsibilities.

To be successful, you’ll bring:

  • Previous experience in the property or real estate industry — essential.
  • Experience in client services, property operations, administration, scheduling or a similar service-based role.
  • Strong relationship-building and communication skills, with the confidence to engage with property industry stakeholders.
  • A commercial mindset and the ability to convert enquiries or warm leads into bookings or sales.
  • Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the initiative to follow matters through to completion.
  • Confidence using business systems, CRM platforms, websites and customer portals, with the ability to learn new technology quickly.
  • The ability to work autonomously while maintaining a high standard of service and accountability.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Competitive package: $85,000 + superannuation, plus a performance bonus.
  • Flexible working: Sydney-based or remote working arrangements.
  • Real ownership: Take responsibility for the day-to-day operation rather than being confined to a traditional administrative role.
  • Variety: Combine property industry relationships, business development, scheduling and operations.
  • Make an impact: Work closely with the Director and contribute directly to client satisfaction, business growth and operational efficiency.

Interested? If you have a background in property or real estate and are looking for a role where you can combine relationship management, commercial thinking and operational ownership, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to find out more.

job.title: Systems Engineer- Healthcare MSP
job.description:
• Norwest Location
  • $110-$120k + super
  • Healthcare experience is a must!

Are you a Systems Engineer with a strong healthcare MSP background and the technical skills to tackle complex infrastructure challenges?

We're partnering with a specialist IT services business to find an experienced Systems Engineer to join their team in Norwest.

This is an opportunity for a technically strong MSP professional who enjoys solving complex technical issues, supporting healthcare clients and delivering infrastructure solutions across diverse client environments.

You'll take ownership of escalated technical issues, contribute to infrastructure projects and provide technical guidance to junior team members.

Important: You must have at least five years' experience working within a healthcare Managed Service Provider (MSP), with hands-on experience supporting healthcare practice management systems.

The opportunity
Reporting to the Service Delivery Manager, you'll provide advanced Level 2 and Level 3 technical support across the helpdesk and projects teams.

You'll work across servers, networking, cloud platforms, virtualisation and security, helping healthcare clients maintain reliable, secure and effective IT environments.

What you'll be doing

  • Provide advanced Level 2 and Level 3 technical support across multiple client environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex server, network, cloud, hardware and software issues.
  • Support healthcare practice management systems, including Medical Director, Best Practice and Genie.
  • Manage escalated tickets and ensure timely resolution within agreed service levels.
  • Deploy, configure and maintain servers, workstations, firewalls, applications and network infrastructure.
  • Administer and support Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory and Group Policy.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, VPNs, wireless networks and firewall technologies.
  • Assist with infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, deployments and project implementations.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation and client environment records.
  • Provide onsite technical support and professional services to clients.
  • Mentor junior technicians and provide technical guidance on complex issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure, processes and service delivery.

What you'll bringEssential experience

  • Minimum five years' experience working within a healthcare Managed Service Provider (MSP).
  • Experience in a Level 2 or Level 3 technical support or Systems Engineer role within an MSP.
  • Hands-on experience supporting healthcare practice management systems, particularly Medical Director, Best Practice and/or Genie.
  • Strong Microsoft infrastructure knowledge, including Windows Server, Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
  • Solid networking and troubleshooting skills across routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs and wireless environments.
  • Experience managing technical escalations and supporting multiple client environments.
  • Strong client communication skills and a customer-focused approach.
  • Current Australian driver's licence and the ability to provide onsite client support.

Technical skills

Ideally, you'll also bring experience across several of the following technologies:

  • Servers: Windows Server 2022/2025, server builds, deployments and troubleshooting.
  • Microsoft: Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
  • Networking and security: Cisco, Fortinet and/or Check Point firewalls, routers, switches and VPNs.
  • Virtualisation: Hyper-V, VMware and/or Citrix environments.
  • Cloud: AWS, including EC2, security solutions and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Business continuity: Backup, disaster recovery and cybersecurity solutions.
  • Projects: Infrastructure upgrades, migrations, deployments and implementation work.

Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, Azure or VMware certifications will be highly regarded.
The person we're looking for

You're a hands-on Systems Engineer who enjoys getting to the root of complex technical problems. You can work independently, manage competing priorities and take ownership of incidents through to resolution.
You communicate technical issues clearly to clients, understand the importance of reliable IT systems in healthcare environments and take pride in delivering quality service.
You'll also enjoy sharing your knowledge, supporting junior technicians and contributing to a collaborative technical team.

What's on offer?

  • Work across complex technical environments and challenging infrastructure projects.
  • Apply your healthcare MSP expertise across a diverse client base.
  • Take ownership of escalated issues and contribute to infrastructure improvements.
  • Share your knowledge and help develop the capability of the wider technical team.
  • Join a business that values technical expertise, collaboration and quality client service.


If you're an experienced Systems Engineer with a strong healthcare MSP background and the technical capability to operate at Level 3, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to find out more about this opportunity.
